en: Black‑and‑white view of a river landscape with two adjacent road bridges crossing a narrow channel between forested banks. The nearer bridge has a metal lattice arch; the farther one has stone abutments and a simple roadway. In the background are low wooden buildings and boathouses on the shoreline of a calm lake or wide river, surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A birch tree trunk and the roofs of a few small houses appear in the foreground. No printed text is visible on the image side.
